items.title: Is First Solar (FSLR) Still Reasonable After Its 45 GW Backlog?
items.summary: First Solar stock has delivered a 154.4% gain over the past 5 years. Over 5 years, First Solar has returned 154.4%, which puts long term holders ahead of many broad equity benchmarks and makes the current price more sensitive to what the company can earn from here.
